_doc: Skill rows per character: assets/skills/<id>_<name>.png is a Gemini picture (magenta background) with the drawings in a grid; build_skill_rows.py cuts, keys, scales and fits them into Sources/OllieBoard/Resources/Sprites/<id>-skills.png and skills.json. height: wanted height of the drawings in px (the median drawing); anchor: fraction of a drawing's width, from its left, that goes to the pet's spot; cx: where that point lands in the 256 px cell (default 128, use less when a prop sticks out to the right) together with shift (points, towards the facing direction) so the character still stands on the pet's spot; ground: feet line in px (default 244); grid: [columns, rows] of the picture (default [4, 2]); frames: use only the first N drawings; level: stand every drawing on the ground line; head_norm: keep the head the same width in every drawing (a belly that swells); loop: false stays on the last frame; inset: px cut off every drawing's edges (divider lines). "redo": {id: [row options]} lists rows of the MAIN sheet drawn again (assets/redo/<id>_<row>.png, build_skill_rows.py --redo <id>), same options.
